body:
blocked: waiting on unimplemented `#1958` prerequisite issues (`#1962`, `#1965`, `#1966`).

Checked `upstream/main` at `31f8d03d` and all 40 open PRs in `NeoTech/Camcraft`:

- `#1962` (open, no PR): `crates/post/src/machine/def.rs`, `crates/post/src/machine/parse.rs`, and `crates/post/src/post/machine.rs` do not yet store rotary nesting order, `pivot`, child `offset`, `zero_offset`, `rollover`, rotary sign convention (`table_rh` / `tool_rh`), or `controller.rtcp` (`machine.rtcp` is still inferred from rotary tilt).
- `#1965` (open, `claimed`, no open PR yet): `crates/post/src/` has no shared Rust AC table-table inverse kinematics solver yet. `#1969` requires calling that shared solver (`lathe_stroke.rs` pattern) and judging `X, Y, Z, A, C` travels on the compensated machine segment sequence it produces.
- `#1966` (open, unclaimed, no PR): `crates/cl/src/cl/` and `crates/post/src/post/` do not yet have `G93` segment timing or explicit 3+2 vs simultaneous section markers needed to check linear and rotary speed ceilings along each segment.

Overlap note for when `#1969` is unblocked: open PR `#1738` adds 3 lines to `crates/app/src/machine/mod.rs` and does not touch `crates/app/src/machine/judge.rs`.

Stopped before claiming (`#1969` left open, not claimed, no branch/worktree/PR created). Drop `blocked` once `#1962`, `#1965`, and `#1966` merge to `main`.
